name: undo-transpose
about: Re-check: a transpose in place, then 'undo that' through take_back.

steps.say: make a deep house groove at 122 with a bassline on track 3
take the bassline down an octave
hmm no, undo that

name: play-the-chorus
about: Re-check: an arrangement, then hear one part of it, then its length.

steps.say: make a pop song arrangement at 104: an intro of 4 bars with just keys, a verse with drums bass and keys, and a chorus where a lead comes in. verse and chorus twice
play me just the chorus
now play the whole song again. how long is it?

name: duck-heard
about: Re-check: a pumping pad, judged by listening to the pad alone.

steps.say: four on the floor kick on track 1 and a held pad chord on track 8. make the pad pump with the kick, then listen and tell me how much it pumps

name: slow-sweep
about: Re-check: an LFO filter sweep at a synced, slow rate.

steps.say: put a long chord on track 4 and give it a slow filter sweep that takes two bars

name: first-beat-lesson
about: A beginner taught to enter a kick themselves; the probe follows the lit keys.

steps.say: I just got my OP-XY and I've never used a sequencer. teach me to put a kick on every beat myself, light the keys for me
did I do it right? what's next?

name: mix-fix
about: A mix problem: diagnose by listening, fix levels and tone.

steps.say: make a lo-fi beat at 80 with drums, a bass and some keys
the bass is way too loud and boomy and the kick gets lost. fix the mix

name: genre-change
about: Turn one style into another, keeping what fits.

steps.say: make a house beat with a bassline
now turn it into drum and bass

name: theory-chords
about: Theory: a progression written and explained.

steps.say: write a sad chord progression in D minor on track 7 and explain why it sounds sad
make the last chord more tense so it pulls back to the start

name: impossible-asks
about: Asks the OP-XY cannot do: handled plainly, with the closest thing.

steps.say: make a 10 bar long melody on track 4
put a hi hat on track 20

name: bass-options
about: Takes to choose from, then a pick by words.

steps.say: make a funk beat at 100
give me three different basslines for it to choose from
I like the second one best, use that
make me a groove in 7/8 at 140

name: kit-808
about: A kit made, then a beat on it.

steps.say: make me an 808 style drum kit and a trap beat that uses it

name: live-performance
about: Teaching performance moves on the replica.

steps.say: make a techno loop at 128
how do I perform this live? I want to drop the kick out and bring it back, and do a filter sweep on everything

name: explain-sound
about: A sound read and explained to a beginner.

steps.say: what is the sound on track 6? explain each page to me like I'm new to synths

name: changed-mind
about: The user changes their mind mid-way.

steps.say: make a techno beat at 130
wait, actually I wanted trap at 140, sorry

name: edits-then-undo
about: The user edits by hand, then asks to undo the agent's last change only.

steps.say: make a simple rock beat on track 1
add a crash on the first step
undo your last change but keep what I just did

name: french-bass
about: French: a bassline, answered in French.

steps.say: fais-moi une ligne de basse funky en mi mineur sur la piste 3
